title: Do NOT buy this!!!
text: Do NOT buy this!!!. We have had this almost a year. When we ordered this it only had a few reviews that were very recent.  We loved how this couch looked w the stitching and the shape, material used and color.  The corner seats are very stiff and not that comfortable, the recliners lasted a month or two. We are so disgusted. This was our Christmas last year and it didn’t make it a year before completely destroyed. The one recliner is not useable, the other one slants and the foot rest will not go back in unless you stand 🤦🏻‍♀️ Save yourselves a lot of money. Get something better.
